socket_source.notes: Mask-based staff-tip proxy; no anatomical guarantee or per-frame correction

transform.resampling: PIL Lanczos; exact isotropic sampling box; integer unmasked paste
transform.calibration: closest nominal scale attaining raster height/centre, search +/-1 output px in .025 px steps

registration_provenance.reason: Requested registration transform cannot be applied to the supplied already-registered 512x512 character frames: its native source_size is 768x1168. Sockets were estimated with transform=None in registered coordinates; the original transform is retained as provenance, not applied twice.

timing: One shared fps; character cycles, VFX once then transparent
compositing: Premultiplied Porter-Duff over; straight RGBA outputs
